Our story

A new name,
with deep roots.

Arelia was founded in 2026 out of two paths coming together: specialist textile know-how in industrial laundry in the Algarve, a strategic B2B outlook, and a shared obsession with detail. We built the premium brand we felt the market was missing.

01 — How it works

Simple, quick,
nothing to worry about.

Four steps. No complications. From collection to delivery, we handle everything so you can concentrate on what actually matters.

01
Step 01

Collection

We come to you at the agreed time. Everything is collected, bagged and counted. No fuss, nothing lost.

02
Step 02

Washing

Industrial treatment done properly. Every item washed, sanitised and treated with the best products available. Rigour in every cycle.

03
Step 03

Finishing

Drying, pressing and precise folding. Linen comes back immaculate, individually wrapped and ready to use.

04
Step 04

Delivery

We deliver within 24 hours, at the agreed time. Every time. Linen arrives perfect, ready for your guests.

Grounded in experience

Capacity kept in check.
Attention at its highest.

Arelia works with a deliberately limited client list. Every hotel gets individual attention, without excessive volume. That is the difference between an industrial laundry and a genuinely premium operation.
